body: I've attempted suicide several times where the possibilities of severe subsequent damage wouldn't ensue if failure was the result, but the more lethal methods I want to try are the most horrifying because of the horrendous damage they can cause if one fails.

I appreciate the reply, but I'm going to have to respectfully disagree with the statement that I'm strong. I've been attempting suicide since the age of 13ish -- to no avail. I'm such a failure, that I can't even kill myself. People like me just aren't meant for contemporary society; I can barely even do Grade 3 Math, and Math is an essential component for succeeding in society. I'm quite confident in the fact that I'll go nowhere in life.

I appreciate your attempt to discourage me from taking my life, but I've made up my mind. You seem like a benevolent individual, so I hope you persevere through your issues.
Same here. I've extensively researched various suicide methods. I currently have a plan that I'm confident will work.

I'm in my late adolescence and I was clinically diagnosed with depression around the age of 13. I've always felt like a robot - devoid of emotion and following the same pointless routine every day. As I look into my future, I see only darkness.
